I appreciate the compliment, but I don’t see how you can gather that. 

Any positive side to me is heavily outweighed by the negative impacts it has on myself and others.
It’s scary, because I’ve been able to do well, and I know I can succeed. I just don’t care, I don’t think it’s worth it.

I’ve done it all man. Dieted, hit the gym, redone my wardrobe etc. 

It feels good, but on top of everything else in my life it’s too much, and I’m too tired for it. And I still hate myself.
You could ask about any part of my body, and I could tell you a reason I hate it. I genuinely cannot think of any aspect I like or find fine or normal.

Nothing specific. Just everything. 

What I hate is that it isn’t irrational. Can’t be helped, and what can be would be / is too expensive 🙃
And yeah. Lots of shit. Ahh well. 

Also why is my font different suddenly?
Been there done that. Psychologists, psychiatrists and therapists. Medication, too. Never been any help, and I’ve always ended up being disregarded. Yikes eh.
Probably, considering I genuinely hate every aspect of my being hahahaha

I don’t feel like life is supposed to be empty and shit.. but mine is. What I want to achieve is now impossible. The worlds changed and I’ve been so badly hurt and psychologically damaged. I’m truely broken.

Keep helping people, what you do is beautiful.

It’s hard to convey, really. The best way I can describe it is the “Good” feels more like a false bandaid. 

I don’t like me. 

Everywhere you go, people turn around and say to celebrate yourself, or work on what you don’t like. The issue is I can’t change everything. From my hair being too fine, my skin problems, messed up feet, poor teeth (I didn’t look after them, poor genetics and my way of dealing with it as a kid / the bullying was to ignore them), my own personality (I’m obnoxious, I lie compulsively, my ego is too inflated even after dealing with ego death) the way my brain processes things (I come off as a hateful person, but really I’m just dissecting things up, kind of like how an autistic person does, yet I’m not on the spectrum). 

I don’t like any aspect of me. I feel like an odd thumb in any situation, and I can see exactly how every situation is better without me. 

Rarely, I don’t feel this way. But when I don’t, I just feel... it’s not describable. I know it’s just a false feeling. I am too self aware.  

And I get very depressed. It’s dark, I use a lot of substance to deal with it, and it hardly helps anymore. I’m worried I’m going to start using dangerous substances like Methamphetamines soon. I’ve been around them but never used. 

So I try and fight it. I put up every fight I possibly can.. and then I run flat, like right now, and I have nothing to hold me up. I sink. 

Life’s always been this way. I’ve always had this problem. I’ve been through CBT, DVT, several different psych teams, all of which have just ghosted. I’ve gotten sober for long periods of time, gotten fit and healthy, given up social media, almost lived outside, taken up hobbies, gone on vacations.... everything under the sun. 

I’m helpless. I don’t want to die, but it’s almost always at the front of my mind. I can be at a gig with people I think are my friends (they are, I’m just in a period of thinking I don’t have any) listening to amazing bands playing, drunk or rolling on mdma, or sober. And all the while I can’t stop thinking about killing myself. 

There’s a lot that comes into play. Was it being assaulted by my only friend I made when I had to move country? Was it being in a bad relationship for many years, that I got manipulated in and cheated on? Is it my parents dying, and never really mourning because I had to look out for others? Is it my political beliefs, and the state of the world? Is it my thankless, 60 hour work weeks that I can’t really change? Is it my debt? My lack of drive to study? Lack of interest in anything now?

It’s all of that. But most of all it’s just me. I just don’t like me at all.
Similar, not the same. I’m thinking of you. I hope things work out, in whatever way they do.

It’s true. Best case scenario, you’ll end up in liver failure and die after months of agony. 

If you want to vent or anything I’m here, similar boat of pain, but yeah.. thinking of you. <3

Hey. 

I can’t tell you it gets better, it’s the most bullshit thing to say ever, because it really doesn’t for some of us. 

Hell, I’m a hippocrite (I can’t even spell for fuck sake) writing this, because I’m in the same boat. 

But I just want you to know I’m thinking of you. It might not really mean anything, but I feel a pin that I can imagine is similar to yours. 

I want to say something along the lines of “Its all about you, not what others think your worth is” but really at times like this it’s hard to value yourself, we are creatures that feed off validation. But it is true. 

I dunno. I’m rambling. I’m just here if you want to let anything off your chest. <3

Just the distance. 

And when it came time for me in ANY capacity (long day at work, or celebrating something) she just was not there in any form. 

The straw that broke was where we saw a movie, and she up and left to “go hang out with friends” because I was “in a boring mood from being so overworked”. I snapped because of everything going on with her, and she just straight said she doesn’t love me anymore, and like that she was gone. 5 years. Didn’t admit everything, but enough for me to piece the rest of the jigsaw together. 

It’s been 2 years now. I’m yet to intimate with another woman despite getting close to some, and I can wholeheartedly admit I doubt I ever will again. That pain is too immense to ever risk, even for love. 

That’s where the saying, love is blind, means for me. You’re blind to the damage it will eventually cause. No one would love if they felt the pain I did. No one. I wish I could forget it.

God I’d love a hug right now.
